name: A Surprising Journey
source:
Ross goes about his daily commute to work when someone new enters his life. Little does Ross know there is a heart-warming surprise in store for him on this journey to work.

[from [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/a-suprising-journey]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当新人进入罗斯的生活时，罗斯就开始每天上班。罗斯并不知道，在这次上班的旅途中，有一个暖心的惊喜等着他。

[来自[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/a-suprising-journey]itch.io[/url]]
